deploybot: Starting hotpatch cutover to prod (eu-west-1)
deploybot: Tagged release: v2026.03.1-hotpatch
deploybot: Commits: 6f4a2be -> 8c9d1f3
deploybot: Change window: 2026-03-20 21:00-21:30 UTC (30m)

maria p: quick q — any DB migrations or schema changes in this patch?
deploybot: No DB migrations. Runtime-only: tokenizer fix + timeout guard for encoder path.

samir: We pinned model-serving image to rwd-model:v1.12.2 in this tag, right? want to avoid the new quant profile.
deploybot: yes — model image pinned. rollout policy: canary (5% traffic, 5 min), then 50%/final.

jen: canary health hooks? what are the signals we watch?
deploybot: canary checks: 99th p99 latency < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, token cost regression < 2%.
deploybot: will auto-abort promote if any check fails.

ops-bot: live canary dashboard -> https://dash.internal/rw/canary/2145839200 (auth required)

maria p: watching logs + traces. will shout if we see increased rejects from request-queue.
deploybot: Canary started at 21:02 UTC (5% traffic)
deploybot: Canary commit: 8c9d1f3

jen: seeing a handful of 503s on one host in eu-west-1-canary, investigating.
maria p: looks like a kube-oom on host ip 10.4.2.7, restarting.

samir: if that host is unhealthy, skip it and continue canary — we want to validate behavior without noisy infra failures.
deploybot: Host removed from canary pool, canary continues -> health: passing (4/5 hosts)

ops-bot: canary metrics snapshot: latency p95 180ms, p99 310ms, errors 0.12%

jen: OK to proceed to 50% if no regressions in next 3 mins
maria p: +1 monitoring green
deploybot: Promoting to 50% at 21:08 UTC
deploybot: Promotion complete -> 50% traffic (rolling across eu-west-1 AZs)

samir: reminder: pinned tokenizer config persisted? some older canaries lost config during rollout before.
maria p: checked, config mounted from s3 release bundle, verified checksum: sha256:fa7b1c0d
deploybot: Final promote starting at 21:15 UTC -> full 100% rollout (gradual, 5 min waves)

ops-bot: release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/v2026.03.1-hotpatch — includes rollback instructions and test prompts
deploybot: Rollout finished at 21:25 UTC -> SUCCESS
deploybot: Deployed tag v2026.03.1-hotpatch to prod eu-west-1

jen: sanity smoke run passed on main routes. no obvious client regressions.
maria p: replayed canary prompt set; outputs match baseline within thresholds.
samir: solid. we'll keep extra 1h monitoring for cost/latency drift.
deploybot: Postflight notes: no DB work, model image pinned, tokenizer checksum verified. No rollbacks triggered.

maria p: leaving a note in the incident tracker for follow-up: check autoscaler thresholds tomorrow morning.
samir: flagging perf regression alert set for +1h (token cost monitor)
deploybot: If any team needs to revert: rollback command (manual):
```
# rollback to previous tagged release
deploybot rollback --env prod --region eu-west-1 --tag v2026.03.0
```

jen: thanks all :thumbsup:
maria p: nice fast turnaround :partyparrot:
samir: thanks, team. good deploy hygiene.
